title: Project state and folder management
description: What an OpenKaava project is, and which one is open in each cluster.
body: A project is a folder — chosen, not defaulted to. A folder becomes an OpenKaava project when it holds a <name>.kaava manifest. An un-marked folder still opens, so OpenKaava can be pointed at a game that exists today, and the frontend can offer to set one up rather than refuse it. The authority on which project is open lives in crate::shell_state::Cluster::project.
